name: nscn_fuel_head
description: PLUT fuel bed in an INSL-lined TTAN case, ballasted in a non-conductive NSCN mound.
why: Save1 'how it works' #1: PLUT bed on top is the neutron source; the NSCN mound around it is ballast/heat mass that can never carry a spark to the case (NSCN will not pass SPRK to PSCN), so the fuel bed can't be triggered from outside -- only by the seeded DEUT/CLNE(NEUT) below it.
source: save1, x226-290 y176-212 (PLUT n=1022 x237-277 y181-205, NSCN mound n=816, TTAN case, INSL liner)
